name: Alpendorf Eberharter
beschreibung: The Alpendorf Eberharter in Stumm consists of several holiday houses and comfortable apartments. The property is located in the scenic Zillertal valley, just a short walk from the center of Stumm. A stay includes direct access to the Erlebnistherme Stumm thermal baths. The accommodations are equipped with a kitchenette, separate bedrooms, and a balcony or terrace. The resort features a children's playground, a sunbathing lawn, and a barbecue area. The village center with its shopping and dining options is easily accessible on foot. The property is especially well-suited for families and self-catering holidaymakers.
